method: Launch: 10rad/s recovered speed drops while feeding, stable goal; 160ms separation. Intake: forward voltage continuously >1V magnitude for200ms, >=8A rise over previous200ms median and >=20% speed reduction;300ms separation. Thresholds uncalibrated. Held20ms grid. Events may merge balls or count oscillation, jams or contact; no precision/recall claims. Pose is estimator output, not ground truth.
